card.name: Partway through repeated medical terms
card.fires_on: Partway through a long medical term or heading that has just appeared earlier in the text, such as CYP3A, Dosage, Hypopituitarism, Asthma or cholelithiasis. It fires on the middle piece, where the rest of the word is easy to predict.
